dependencies.version_policy: Install these exact primary package versions and fail on toolchain drift; do not silently update dependencies.

validation.scope: Primary Ubuntu x86_64 contract toolchain/package snapshot; generated C++20 contracts and clean-directory code-generation repeat verified

limitations: Not a hermetic or bit-for-bit binary reproducibility claim: runner image and transitive system packages are not fully pinned.

Unavailable exact package versions or observed toolchain drift must fail CI and require an explicit lock refresh.
